text:
Renee Park: Quick one 46a3fb 4e7 - hoping to take 6 weeks parental leave starting in ~5 weeks, but well be spending 3 of those weeks visiting family overseas. Do I need any extra paperwork to keep the newborn on benefits while abroad? Also curious if the childcare stipend covers daycare costs incurred while I'm traveling before official return.

Tom (Manager): Congrats Renee! :tada: Practical Q: do you plan to remain on US payroll while abroad? That affects benefits.

Renee Park: Yes, staying on US payroll. Just a short visit and will remain reachable. Trying to avoid switching providers mid-leave.

Priya (People Ops): Congrats!! Short answers: if you remain on US payroll and maintain benefit enrollment, coverage continues internationally but some carriers have limited out-of-country coverage. Upload travel dates + address and well confirm with Benefits. For childcare stipend: stipend is paid based on weeks on leave and approved receipts; travel-week daycare can be eligible if its a reimbursable expense.

Priya (People Ops): Docs we need: leave request (DocuSign), travel notice (simple form), dependent enrollment confirmation (if adding newborn), and any agency/adoption placement docs if applicable. You can e-sign now and update travel dates later.

Renee Park: Great. If I need urgent payroll/top-up adjustments while I'm away, who do I contact?

payroll-bot: To change top-up percent or request retro pay, email payroll@redwood.com and include leave start date and employee ID. For changes during an active leave, submit at least 3 business days before payroll cutoff; retro adjustments can be processed after confirmation.

Priya (People Ops): Also note: if youre out of state/country, we'll need a local mailing address for any physical forms. For the newborn, upload the birth certificate within 30 days for dependent enrollment. If you miss the 30-day window, file an appeal and well attempt retro enrollment on a case-by-case basis.

Tom (Manager): Coverage plan: I can do a 2-week overlap with Renee before she leaves and then Sam will be primary contact. Renee, want me to post this handoff?

Renee Park: Yes please. A short handoff paragraph would be great. Also need IT to approve short-term contractor access for 8 weeks; will DM the details.

people-ops-bot: HR ticket created: HR-PL-2026-599. People Ops will follow up with the travel form and dependent enrollment checklist within 1 business day.

Tom (Manager): Handoff snippet (copy/paste):
```
Hi team,
Renee will be on parental leave from START_DATE to END_DATE and will be partly abroad during the leave. Primary contact: Tom (tom@redwood.com). Coverage: Sam will handle day-to-day; contractor NAME covers backlog. Runbooks: <link>. Renee will do a 2-week overlap before START_DATE for handoff. For urgent infra incidents contact the on-call rotation. Thanks.
```

Renee Park: Perfect, thanks everyone 49a. I'll upload travel dates and the birth cert when ready.
